exposure: cesarean delivery (CD) bundle (preoperative vaginal preparation, cefazolin, azithromycin)
outcome: postoperative infections (endometritis, surgical-site infection, abscess, urinary tract infection, postpartum fever)
cohort: The study participants were women who underwent cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor.
finding: The cesarean delivery bundle, including preoperative azithromycin and vaginal cleansing in addition to cefazolin, was efficacious in reducing postoperative infections and composite infectious morbidity among women undergoing CD during the second stage of labor.
mod_finding: The study found that implementing a specific bundle during second-stage cesarean delivery significantly reduced postoperative infectious morbidity.
